gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically confirmed glioblastoma (GBM), with first recurrence after prior surgery, chemotherapy, and/or radiotherapy.

candidate_evidence.quote: Participants will receive YSCH-01 in combination with atezolizumab. YSCH-01 will be administered via intratumoral or intratumoral cavity injection through an implanted Ommaya reservoir, and atezolizumab will be administered intravenously.
Atezolizumab (PD-L1 inhibitor) will be administered via intravenous infusion on Day 8 of each cycle at a dose of 1200 mg.

role_evidence.quote: YSCH-01 will be administered via intratumoral or intratumoral cavity injection through an implanted Ommaya reservoir on Day 1 of each cycle at a dose of 5.0 × 10¹⁰ viral particles (VP).

agents.drug_class_hint: YSCH-01, adenovirus-based (presumed oncolytic) virus given intratumorally via Ommaya reservoir

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive YSCH-01 in combination with atezolizumab.
Evaluating Safety, Tolerability, and Preliminary Efficacy of YSCH-01 Monotherapy and in Combination With Atezolizumab for Recurrent Glioblastoma

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 record (translational subset). YSCH-01 is described only as an adenovirus dosed in viral particles; treated as an oncolytic virus/gene-therapy vector (excluded type either way). Atezolizumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent, in the combination arm only. Brief summary says 'randomized' but design field says NON_RANDOMIZED.
